name: cosmic-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by Giuseppe Bellamacina.

plugins.name: setup-sync
plugins.description: Push/pull your whole Claude Code setup (settings, plugins, MCP servers, skills, agents, hooks, LSP, mods) to a local folder; the agent replays the install of external tools on a new machine.

plugins.name: pr-review-helper
plugins.description: Find open GitHub pull requests with no review yet (by repo, user or topic, sorted by popularity or date) and write targeted reviews you confirm before they are posted under your own account.

plugins.name: prompt-queue
plugins.description: Type >> on and messages sent while Claude works wait until the current task is finished, in an editable queue above the prompt; >> off is back to normal, and >> lines never reach Claude's history. /now <message> interrupts and sends at once.

plugins.name: omniboard
plugins.description: Claude's plan in a local browser board you can edit while it works (micro-steps, skip, reorder, stop; finished sections locked), with its progress above the prompt, its subagents and background tasks, and session statistics.

plugins.name: downtime
plugins.description: While Claude works, opens the windows you chose (a feed, a film, a PDF, a program you confirmed) and minimizes them when Claude needs you or is done. Claude can open and minimize them on request.

plugins.name: sound-alerts
plugins.description: Notification sounds for Claude Code: when Claude finishes, asks you something, needs a permission, runs tests or hits a limit. Two presets come with it, and a preset of your own is a folder of .wav files.
